description: This file defines application configuration settings loaded from environment variables, using Pydantic's BaseModel for validation. It includes a Settings class with required fields for Supabase URL, anon key, and site URL, and a cached function to retrieve and validate these settings.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: A Pydantic model representing configuration settings loaded from environment variables, including Supabase URL, anon key, and site URL.

methods.name: Settings get_settings()
methods.description: Loads and caches application settings from environment variables, validating presence of required variables, and raises detailed error if any are missing.

ctags.name: SITE_URL
ctags.pattern: /^    SITE_URL: str = Field(..., description="Public site URL for redirect links")$/

ctags.name: SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
ctags.pattern: /^    SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: str = Field(..., description="Supabase anon key")$/

ctags.name: SUPABASE_URL
ctags.pattern: /^    SUPABASE_URL: str = Field(..., description="Supabase project URL")$/
